short_bio: British broadcaster and naturalist whose BBC series have defined the nature documentary.
biography:
David Attenborough studied natural sciences at Clare College, Cambridge, and joined the BBC in 1952. Zoo Quest, which began in 1954, took him on animal-collecting expeditions.

As controller of BBC Two from 1965 he helped launch colour television in Britain. He left management to make Life on Earth (1979), followed by The Living Planet, The Blue Planet (2001), Planet Earth (2006) and Blue Planet II (2017).

He was later knighted. His brother was the actor and director Richard Attenborough.
